title: The Summer of Sandpiper Point
author: Freya Crane
blurb: Petra Thornbury, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
